title: BASELINE-001 Authority — canonical truth for baseline inheritance surfaces
authority: AUTHORED REPOSITORY TRUTH, HELD AS A PROJECTION UNDER UCKP-LAW-0001. This instrument holds the canonical data that BASELINE-001's surfaces must project. It creates no authority beyond what BASELINE-001's declaration already establishes.

constitutional_superior.effect: UCKP-ART-11 makes generated output a view that never owns truth. This authority extracts the truth BASELINE-001 already holds so UFI can verify surfaces against it. UCKP-ART-18 requires reuse before creation; this instrument reuses BASELINE-001's existing data rather than authoring a second copy.

why_this_exists: MB7 — BASELINE-001 validates only by its own programme. baseline_engine.py emits baseline.json
and markdown surfaces, then validates those surfaces by reading baseline.json again. A generator
that is uniformly wrong emits self-consistent output, and every check derived from that same run
agrees with it. BASELINE-001 cannot be shown CORRECT, only CONSISTENT.
This authority extracts the canonical data from baseline.json so UFI can verify BASELINE-001's
markdown surfaces independently. UFI reads this authority and the surfaces, but never imports,
executes or reads baseline_engine.py — breaking the self-validation loop.
